verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents versioning, time-travel and branching for its tables, which is data versioning rather than versioning, review or rollback of automations. Nothing in the evidence describes automations, workflows or pipelines that can be versioned, reviewed or rolled back. Because LanceDB positions itself as a lakehouse platform with feature engineering, the axis applies, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
